subject.title: improve: stream native sessions as hosts finish

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose progressive host completion through the public `SessionCatalogListProviderParams.onHost` callback and `sessions.catalog.host` Gateway event?
rationale: This is an additive plugin SDK and Gateway protocol contract that third-party providers and clients may rely on; its permanence and compatibility obligations require maintainer intent beyond a local implementation review.

options.title: Adopt the progressive contract
options.body: Accept `onHost` and `sessions.catalog.host` as supported additive APIs, with the aggregate response retained as the authoritative compatibility snapshot.

options.title: Keep progress internal
options.body: Rework the feature so progressive delivery remains within core-owned providers and UI paths without expanding the public provider callback surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt the progressive contract
recommendation.body: Accept `onHost` and `sessions.catalog.host` as supported additive APIs, with the aggregate response retained as the authoritative compatibility snapshot.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR establishes the proposed contract across the provider, Gateway, and Control UI layers.
